name: Tabnine
tagline: Enterprise AI dev platform whose Code Review Agent checks PRs against plain-language team rules on GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.
pricing: Code Assistant platform $39/user/mo, Agentic platform $59/user/mo (annual billing); no free tier listed as of Aug 2026
selfHostedNote: Both plans list SaaS, VPC, on-premises, and air-gapped deployment options.
modelControl: Choose from Tabnine's supported models incl. its protected model; private/self-hosted model deployments supported

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Enterprise context engine draws on codebase awareness; no documented multi-repo dependency resolution.

02-rule-centric.note: Prebuilt plus fully customizable plain-language rules; changed lines are checked against team rules.

03-dual-workflow.note: Reviews run in the IDE, via CLI (pre-commit hooks), and on pull requests.

04-business-logic.note: Separate Jira Validation Agent checks code against Jira issue requirements.

05-continuous-learning.note: No documented learning from review feedback over time.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No sandbox execution or runtime validation documented.

07-economic-transparency.note: Model switching within a vendor-supported list and on-prem model hosting; no pay-your-own-provider BYOK.

08-actionability.note: Flags rule deviations with guidance and suggested edits; committable-fix flow not documented.

09-measurable-roi.note: Analytics dashboard tracks usage and acceptance; no DORA or review-ROI attribution.
